_comment: Curated body-hunger fuel specs per engine (analysis/engine_coaching.md Plan 2 Layer B). Keyed by the PAYOFF card id (the engine piece that must sit ON BOARD for the feed-the-engine line). fuel_tribe: the body type that feeds it; trigger: what action with a body pays out (play | sell | summon); payoff: 'quality_independent' means ANY body of the tribe pays - quantity beats quality (encoded from the payoff card's own text: Unbound Tempest gains the TAVERN's stats whatever Elemental you played; Meteorite Crasher's +4/+4 is per Elemental SOLD). The feed-the-engine line fires only when the engine piece is on board, the tavern is past the early tempo window (tier >= 4), and gold is idle after the plan's real buys - a spend recommendation inside the committed build, never a comp-target override.

BG36_352.text: After you play 3 Elementals, gain the stats of the highest-Health minion in the Tavern.
BG36_352.why: every Elemental played feeds Unbound Tempest

BG32_846.text: After you play an Elemental, give your Elementals +2/+3.
BG32_846.why: every Elemental played feeds Unleashed Mana Surge

BG31_843.text: After you sell an Elemental, gain +4/+4.
BG31_843.why: every Elemental sold feeds Meteorite Crasher
